name: One-Arm Bent Over Row
instructions: Hinge forward with a flat back, bracing one hand on a bench.
Row the dumbbell to your hip, driving the elbow toward the ceiling.
Squeeze the back at the top for a full second.
Lower slowly. Unilateral rows build thickness and fix imbalances.
cues: Pull the elbows to the ribs
longevityNotes: Pull twice as much as you push and your posture will age well. Rowing and pull-up strength are among the best predictors of a capable, pain-free upper body later in life.
overview: A beginner dumbbell pull-pattern exercise for the lats. One-Arm Bent Over Row strengthens the back of the upper body, which pays off in posture and shoulder health.
